# 1444 actual-live candidate — independent visual bar-raiser

**PASS for the frozen native live visual gate, with sampled temporal review.** No further art revision or supplementary capture is required by this review. The connected undercroft and balcony recesses improve the older flat dark fields and projecting shelves in ordinary third-person context. The lower-balcony supplement resolves the prior avatar-occlusion gap. This decision grants no recognition credit or package, mechanical, authority or release acceptance: capture-time authority remains **9/213, +0**.

Reviewer: `review_1439_package`, acting as the separate 1444 visual bar-raiser, 2026-09-09. I read AGENTS.md completely and authored none of the 1444 art, source, mechanics or capture driver. I launched no engine and changed no product, authority or image. I independently opened every image listed below at original detail and checked their exact identities against the final frozen handoff.

## Visual decision

- **Substantive improvement:** all six matched study pairs were freshly inspected. Compared with the older black face panels, proud frames and detached shelf shadows, the current undercrofts have continuous side/support thickness, inner top shade and an inset back/floor relationship. The balcony rails now stand in front of a visible back within an aperture; removing the external shelves makes the two levels belong to the wall. The gain is strongest in the changed-light near pairs, and remains coherent in the actual live views. The comparison is matched within the isolated study; the live-world terrain and surrounding buildings are a separate context, not a pixel-matched old/live pair.
- **Ordinary gameplay composition:** live 01, 02 and 05 keep the broad blank upper end over two unequal ground fields, followed by sparse paired openings and the narrow far two-level stack. The balcony remains subordinate at road distance. The restrained stucco and shallow dark eave preserve the hierarchy. There is no new generic bay strip, roof decoration or visually busy treatment on the exposed neutral returns.
- **Undercroft depth:** live 04/07 show two connected exterior pockets with a solid support between them. In changed light, top shade and right-hand inner returns distinguish the backs from the front plane. Default light makes these shallow pockets darker and less explicit. They remain opaque closed exterior proxies; these views do not establish a walk-through breezeway or an interior.
- **Lower balcony:** original live 03/06 left the lower center/floor partly behind the avatar. Supplement 08/09 moves the framing enough to expose the whole lower aperture above the avatar. In 09 the back, floor, inner left return, upper shade and rail are readable together. The rail endpoints visually meet the aperture boundary. Default-light 08 keeps the complete outline and rails readable but offers weaker depth contrast. The supplemental pair closes the specific missing observation without an art change.
- **Sampled motion:** all 17 extracted native AVI images and all seven in-run PNGs were individually inspected in order. Both balcony levels remain readable as they move left across the frame. Narrow illuminated return edges change smoothly in the inspected sequence; no detached rail end, opening collapse, gross pop or bright seam jump is visible in those samples. Late frames crop much of the broad facade at the left border, but retain both balcony levels and the adjacent return. This is useful return-edge evidence, not a whole-building motion composition claim.

The approved written 1444 packet supports the blank-end/undercroft plus offset sparse-return/recessed-stack cue pair on WSW runs 8,9,11,12,15,16,17. Those cues are readable without address, location or tan color doing the identification. The composition differs from 1431's garage-wing/two-stair/siding-band combination and 1436's paired bays/aprons/bracketing stairs. The 1449 packet has no usable target appearance cues; I do not claim a complete photographic confusion-set test. I used the retained written observations and rights boundary, obtained no new imagery, and make no new currentness or as-built claim. Depth, cadence and dimensions remain production inference. Exact protected-surface preservation and collision/spray behavior belong to the independent source/mechanical gates; these views only show the exposed neutral faces remaining quiet.

## Evidence inspected and identity

I viewed **nine native live stills**, **all twelve native matched study originals**, **seven motion PNGs**, and **17 unmodified native AVI JPEG payloads** at zero-based indices `128,143,158,173,188,203,218,233,248,263,278,293,308,323,338,353,368`.

All 28 PNGs match their recorded hashes and actual 1440×900 dimensions. The 17 JPEG files match the corresponding payload bytes inside the complete 31,902,858-byte AVI. Its header and actual image chunks agree on 381 frames, 1280×800; the terminal engine log reports 60 fps, giving 6.35 seconds including startup/settling. The RIFF declared end is byte 31,902,788, 70 bytes short of physical EOF at 31,902,858 within the trailing index chunk; every complete image chunk precedes it. I parsed physical file bounds and do not claim general-player playback validity.

All three native manifests' source pins match the actual candidate files: 25 unique paths including the distinct original/supplement drivers. The factory/config/backing/camera remain identical to the accepted study pins. All nine recorded poses are grounded, use the ordinary player rig and input-reachable camera orientation, and identify `building:w95934117:wall` through expected runs 9/17/8. Translation repeat error is zero; maximum recorded basis error is `1.03774581816651e-07`. These checks validate the capture record, not an independent physics replay.

The three capture execution receipts and their logs are exact, clean and terminal with exit 0: original stills PID 83838, supplement PID 84716, motion PID 84922. Their recorded before/after pins are unchanged and their completion receipts report absent PIDs. The owner separately confirmed final freeze and GPU release. The measured live world recorded with these captures is **735 rows / 968 meshes / 983 surfaces / 71,364 triangles / 466 bodies / 467 shapes**; this is the isolated 1444 candidate on the published base, not the separate 1439 candidate or a combined world.

The independently inspected first-study report remains unchanged at `../1444-quality-v2-independent-visual-001/REVIEW.md`; this review extends it to the frozen actual-live evidence rather than rewriting its historical decision.

## Temporal and acceptance limits

The 240 input samples are all grounded with zero recovery or transform writes during input. Their measured planar displacement is **15.70616234803271 m**; the raw 15.8664894104004 m includes twelve subsequent settling frames. Physics counters, process counters and encoded AVI indices are distinct. The 17 extracted indices are representative samples across the advertised segment; exact one-to-one counter alignment is not established. The seven PNG physics labels also are not exact draw timestamps.

This is **sampled temporal acceptance**, not continuous playback or proof of every intervening rendered frame. It cannot rule out momentary shimmer/flicker between samples. No remaining concrete visual gap requires another capture or art change for this bounded gate. Later source combination, package validation and recognition promotion require their own separately bound decisions.
